kind: reduced copy of the production detector

symbols: exit 2 is never downgraded by mode
surfaces[] row shape: id, path_pattern, path_literals, writers[].anchor, read_back[].reaches, content, integrity, tamper_evident, watched_by, channel_class

volatile: The production registry holds one row per factory surface over six scan trees and declares a count for every boundary of the real handoff envelope; this one holds three rows, one tree and a two-boundary schema written for the demo.
The production self-test plants 18 cases at run time; this one plants 13, and its file plants are committed under fixtures/planted/ and overlaid one at a time.

Dropped: the OFF/WARN/BLOCK mode switch, the report file, the --list/--census/--json flags, the `*` segment in scan trees, the symlink skip and the scan-size floor. The four checks and the exit-2 doctrine are copied unchanged, node built-ins only.

tamper.expect_line: SELF_TEST_FAILED — refusing to inspect the fixture tree.
